entities.span: The authenticated app's page inventory, navigation, post sign in destination and header,
rejected_spans: the gap features 9, 11 and 12 were each about to invent on their own.
whose done when clause needs no decided shell.

entities.span: **Done when:** `/search`, `/profile` and `/applications` exist as real routes with only the first two in the signed in nav;
one header component renders its signed in variant from `(app)/layout.tsx` and its signed out variant from the marketing layout;
a user with no profile row lands on `/profile` and everyone else on `/`, with feature 14's later scoring gate layered on top rather than replacing it;
a deep link followed while signed out survives sign in and returns the visitor to it, rejecting anything that is not a single leading slash path;
the signed in shell needs no hamburger, drawer or tab bar at 320 pixels;
and a signed in visitor at `/` no longer sees a sign in invitation, without `/` reading the session.

Design it (spec): `/architect app shell & navigation` · done 2026-08-31, spec 0008 at **revision 5**. The spec amends this row's **Done when** wording in two places, and `/develop` records both against the row when the feature ships. First, "everyone else on `/`" becomes `/search`. Second, "its signed out variant from the marketing layout" becomes each marketing page composing it.
rejected_spans: because that wording predates the settled decision that `/` is the static marketing page
because a layout never learns the pathname and the row's phrasing assumed it could

entities.span: Build it: `/develop app shell & navigation` · done 2026-08-31 on `feat/app-shell-and-navigation`, seven code commits. All four gates green (lint, format, typecheck, `pnpm build`), 365 unit tests and 52 integration tests passing, and the whole thread driven in a real browser against the local stack. **The `Done when` wording above is amended in three places, recorded here rather than edited into it**. The third was found during this build: "renders its signed in variant from `(app)/layout.tsx`" is now each route under `(app)` composing it, and **spec 0008's AC-3a carries that amendment as of revision 5**.
rejected_spans: so the row still reads as it was written when the feature was scoped
because AC-3a and AC-5 cannot both hold

entities.span: The return path thread, end to end: the two shared modules and the validator, the proxy echoing the requested path as a header, the layout appending `?next=`, `/sign-in` carrying it, the Server Actions writing the cookie, the callback consuming and clearing it · **AC-5b**, **AC-6**, **AC-7**, **AC-7a**, **AC-8**, **AC-9**, **AC-10**, **AC-10a**, **AC-11** to **AC-16**, **AC-24a**. **That mechanic holds, measured rather than reasoned about on 2026-08-31**: the cookie a Server Action writes survives that action's redirect off site. **The recorded fallback is not needed.** The proxy's half is locked by an integration test that fails when the headers are hoisted, checked by reintroducing that exact bug

The door, the entry page swap and the sign in bounce: `/go` with `no-store`, `/` losing every provider form, and a signed in visitor at `/sign-in` bounced · **AC-17**, **AC-17a**, **AC-18**, **AC-19**, **AC-20**. `/` still builds as a static prerender, so its accepted contract holds. The band's opening clause "Sign in with Google or GitHub" was **deleted at the engineer's direction**,
rejected_spans: since AC-18 asks for no sign in invitation anywhere and the spec's Copy table did not cover that sentence

entities.span: The shell itself: the chrome only header, the marketing pages composing their own variant, the three routes with their copy slots, `/health` tidied · **AC-1** to **AC-5a**, **AC-21**, **AC-22**, **AC-23**. **AC-4 failed on first measurement and is now fixed**: the 190 pixel lockup left 82 pixels at 320, so every route under the shell overflowed. The chrome now renders the mark below `sm` and the lockup above it, and all seven routes measure exactly 320 by 320
The three span names registered in `docs/observability/spans.md` · **AC-24**
Verify it: `/check verify app shell & navigation` · **PASS** on 2026-08-31, all 24 acceptance criteria met and all 28 steps in verify.md ticked with the observation that proved each one.
